# DQN descriptive comparison on D0 cells

> **not preregistered; descriptive only; no threshold, no equivalence test; not part of the 15-pair adjudication family; RQ2 remains "not run"**

## Scope and computation

- Metric: NMSE; lower is better.
- Raw difference: `DQN cross-graph mean − X cross-graph mean`, where `X ∈ {CEM, B3a, B3b, B3c}`. A positive difference means DQN's NMSE is higher.
- Unit of resampling: 10 paired graphs within each D0 cell. For DQN and CEM, the three method seeds are averaged within each graph before graph-level resampling; B3a/B3b/B3c have one deterministic record per graph. This is the per-graph scalar convention.
- Bootstrap: `B = 100000`, seed `3906`, `numpy.random.default_rng`; cell-major order `G1_S1` through `G3_S3`, opponent order `CEM, B3a, B3b, B3c`; percentile 95% interval with NumPy linear quantiles.
- The interval is reported descriptively. No threshold, δ, TOST, equivalence label, or pass/fail predicate is applied.

## Data sources

- DQN: nine `runs/sealed/dqn_d0_G*_S*_k10_N100.jsonl` objects generated at `24713b48d5dd026bf3102d1f1b7f3e65ae2b790d`; use authorized by SEAL-only commit `06ec8b35e4f98da9b35c70e1609ace929963a13a`.
- CEM/B3a/B3b/B3c graph-level arrays: `runs/k2_aggregate.json` @ `c130353897c0c1db1e208141cc82d9245874ab46`, content SHA-256 `9711c2c6dcff5681d16a5b45bb97b13c2b78fc206944f3c8faeac12b955143e6`.
- DQN graph-level means recomputed from the nine sealed JSONL objects match `runs/k3_verdict_table.json` exactly within absolute tolerance `1e-15`; the 27 B3a/B3b/B3c graph arrays match their open D0 JSONL records at the same tolerance.
